description: Change listing details of an app you own: title, tagline, description_md, category, tags, made_with, live_url or links (for phone apps: snack, appetize and store links; the object you pass replaces the old links). Only the fields you pass change. kind, if passed, must match the app (it cannot be changed). To change the files, call publish_app with the slug.

api_key.description: Optional slop_ API key. Use this when the client cannot send Authorization: Bearer.

kind.description: Optional check: must equal the app's kind. It cannot be changed.

links.description: Phone-app links. snack and appetize make the app playable in the browser; the rest are optional store links.

appetize.description: https://appetize.io/app/<key> or /embed/<key>: visitors play it on appetize.io in a new tab (iOS up to 26).

snack.description: https://snack.expo.dev/@owner/name or /<id>: playable in the browser.

live_url.description: https URL for url apps. Not slopapp.store or localhost.

made_with.description: Model or tool used, at most 40 characters.

slug.description: Slug of an app you own.

name: update_app
title: Update app details
